slateBrief.brief_text:
Tom Kim finished the Genesis Scottish Open at 17-under par today, claiming the title after a 5-under final round. Min Woo Lee followed at 15-under par, while the trio of Johnny Keefer, Keita Nakajima, and Robert MacIntyre finished tied for third at 13-under par.

Allisha Gray’s 18.7 PPG this season anchors the Dream as they host a Sparks team led by Nneka Ogwumike’s 16.9 PPG this season. Meanwhile, the Lynx rely on Olivia Miles’s 18.7 PPG this season to counter the Mercury, who bring Kahleah Copper’s 20.3 PPG this season into the matchup. Whether the Lynx defense contains Copper or the Dream sustain their 90.6 points scored per game last 5 games will decide the evening.

priorBrief.brief_text:
Vancouver FC traveled to Stade Saputo for a TELUS Canadian Championship match against CF Montréal on July 12, 2026. In MLB action, the Pirates secured a 14-5 win over the Brewers, while the Orioles defeated the Royals 8-2. The Yankees edged the Nationals 5-3, the Red Sox took a 3-2 victory against the Mets, and the Cubs beat the Reds 8-4. Elsewhere, the Guardians topped the Marlins 5-2, the Phillies shut out the Tigers 5-0, and the Mariners beat the Rays 8-2. The Twins defeated the Angels 4-2, the White Sox beat the Athletics 9-1, the Braves edged the Cardinals 4-3, the Rangers won 6-5 against the Astros, the Giants beat the Rockies 3-1, the Diamondbacks won 5-3 against the Dodgers, and the Padres beat the Blue Jays 5-4.

WNBA play saw the Tempo defeat the Liberty 93-91, while the Mystics beat the Storm 84-79. The Wings topped the Sky 96-91, and the Fever defeated the Aces 109-75 tonight. At the Genesis Scottish Open, Tom Kim finished the fourth round at -17 tonight.

narratives: PNC Park hosts this doubleheader makeup game between the 59-34 Brewers and 47-47 Pirates. Nick Gonzales enters with a .310 BA this season, while Brandon Lowe provides 21 HR and 64 RBI this season. William Contreras holds a .281 BA this season, and Jake Bauers adds 17 HR and 57 RBI this season.

Shane Drohan brings a 2.97 ERA this season to PNC Park against Bubba Chandler, who carries a 4.82 ERA this season. Brewers hitters track William Contreras’s .281 BA this season, while Pirates fans watch Nick Gonzales’s .310 BA this season. This Brewers 0, Pirates 0 matchup hinges on Brandon Lowe’s 64 RBI this season.

Busch Stadium hosts this doubleheader nightcap as the 55-33 Brewers face the 47-40 Cardinals on MLB.TV. Jordan Walker enters with a .292 BA, 20 HR, and 67 RBI this season. William Contreras maintains a .295 BA this season, while Jake Bauers contributes 16 HR and 54 RBI this season.

Jacob Misiorowski carries a 1.47 ERA this season into Busch Stadium for this doubleheader opener. The 55-33 Brewers face the 47-40 Cardinals, who rely on Jordan Walker’s .292 BA this season. William Contreras holds a .295 BA this season, while Jake Bauers contributes 16 HR this season for Milwaukee.

Folarin Balogun enters this FIFA World Cup match at Lumen Field with 3 goals this tournament, while Youri Tielemans carries 2 goals this tournament into the fixture. FOX broadcasts this 0-0 matchup between Belgium and the USA. Both teams seek their first goal of the game tonight.

Cristiano Ronaldo leads Portugal into AT&T Stadium with 3 goals scored this tournament, while Mikel Oyarzabal anchors Spain with 4 goals scored this tournament. FOX broadcasts this matchup between Spain and Portugal following their 0-0 draw this tournament. Spain and Portugal kick off at AT&T Stadium to decide this tournament fixture.

Los Angeles Sparks (8-10) host the Seattle Storm (5-17) tonight at crypto.com Arena on USA Net. Nneka Ogwumike leads the Sparks with 16.2 PPG and 8.5 RPG this season, while Natisha Hiedeman paces the Storm with 15.5 PPG and 4.5 APG this season. Erica Wheeler adds 4.7 APG this season.

Minnesota holds a 15-game lead in the standings over Connecticut as the 15-5 Lynx host the 4-16 Sun at Target Center. Olivia Miles leads Minnesota with 18.5 PPG this season, while Aaliyah Edwards averages 9.8 PPG for Connecticut. Catch the action tonight on WNBA League Pass.

Valkyries hold a 14-7 record entering this matchup against the 10-9 Mystics at CareFirst Arena. Sonia Citron averages 18.6 PPG this season, while Kiki Iriafen grabs 9.2 RPG and Georgia Amoore dishes 3.8 APG. Gabby Williams leads Golden State with 16.0 PPG, Kayla Thornton adds 5.1 RPG, and Veronica Burton provides 5.3 APG.

Kyle Freeland carries a 7.25 ERA this season into Dodger Stadium against Eric Lauer, who holds a 4-5 record this season. Rockies (37-54) face Dodgers (59-31) as Shohei Ohtani brings 18 HR this season and Hunter Goodman adds 27 HR this season. Watch this MLB.TV broadcast tonight.
